# Both internal and external test declarations are registered before TestMain.
# Separate marked packages share descriptors in a multi-package invocation.
go test ./...
stdout '^ok\s+example.com/isolate-tests/a'
stdout '^ok\s+example.com/isolate-tests/b'
go test -c -o a.test ./a
exec ./a.test -test.run TestInternalEntry
stdout PASS

-- go.mod --
module example.com/isolate-tests
go 1.26
require github.com/stretchr/testify v0.0.0
replace github.com/stretchr/testify => ./testify
-- a/a.go --
package a
var State = 7
-- a/a_test.go --
package a
import (
 "isolate"
 "os"
 "testing"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/suite"
)
//temporal:workflow
func internalEntry(v int) (int, error) { State++; return State+v,nil }
func TestMain(m *testing.M) {
 if _,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(internalEntry);!ok { panic("internal entry missing before TestMain") }
 os.Exit(m.Run())
}
func TestInternalEntry(t *testing.T) {
 suite.Run()
 h,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(internalEntry)
 if !ok || h.Signature().NumIn()!=1 { t.Fatal("internal entry missing or wrong signature") }
 if State!=7 {t.Fatal("registration ran workflow code")}
}
-- a/external_test.go --
package a_test
import (
 "example.com/isolate-tests/c"
 "isolate"
 "testing"
)
//temporal:workflow
func externalEntry() error { return nil }
func TestExternalEntry(t *testing.T) {
 if _,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(externalEntry);!ok {t.Fatal("external entry missing")}
 if _,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(c.Entry);!ok {t.Fatal("dependency without tests missing")}
}
-- b/b.go --
package b
//temporal:workflow
func Entry() error { return nil }
-- b/b_test.go --
package b
import (
 "isolate"
 "testing"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/testmock"
)
func TestImportedEntry(t *testing.T) {
 if testmock.New()!=7 {t.Fatal("late test-only dependency missing")}
 if _,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(Entry);!ok {t.Fatal("ordinary source entry missing")}
}
-- c/c.go --
package c
//temporal:workflow
func Entry() error {return nil}
-- testify/go.mod --
module github.com/stretchr/testify
go 1.26
-- testify/suite/suite.go --
package suite
import (
 "fmt"
 "os"
)
// Host test helpers must not become workflow package state.
//go:noinline
func Run() { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "host suite") }
-- testify/testmock/mock.go --
package testmock
func New() int {return 7}
